column1: # Golden poster widths: real Malayalam text, measured in a real browser.
# text <TAB> size <TAB> canvas <TAB> rendered_px <TAB> what it covers
# MEASURED, not derived. Taken in the browser on 2026-08-26 with
# frontend/public/fonts/NotoSansMalayalam.woff2 actually loaded, on the A4
# portrait preset (2480 x 3508 px, safe box 2083 px wide). Recorded in
# NEXT.md 0.2.
# These exist because a Malayalam headline overflow is NOT catchable by eye and
# not catchable by the backend either: its Pillow has no HarfBuzz, so it cannot
# shape a conjunct (see backend/features/posters.py). The numbers below are the
# only ground truth this project has about how wide Malayalam actually renders.
# What the tests assert (tests/test_posters.py):
#   * `fit_block` given the measured width brings every one of these inside the
#     safe box — the bug in 0.2 was that "Focus Digitals" in Malayalam ran to
#     231% of the page at the default headline size.
#   * The backend's own estimate classifies each row the same way the
#     measurement does, or errs toward "does not fit". Never the other way.
# "Focus Digitals" is the shop's own name and an entirely ordinary one. That it
# did not fit at any size that reads as a headline is the whole point.
